experiment_template.research_question: Can one additional exhaustive terminal correction close the observed state valid-completion gap within the same cumulative model-token cap?
stop_conditions: A third invalid terminal response stops that cell and remains in the denominator.
Every Round 21 identity runs once; no Round 20 identity is resumed or rerun.
No task, state, prompt, order, context/output/total-token cap, scorer or threshold change.
Shared integrity and unknown-usage failures still stop globally.

records.falsifier: Any third correction dispatches, a correction exceeds the unchanged token/call cap, diagnostic issues are hidden, failed tokens disappear, a correction causes repository effects, state valid completion remains below control, or scheduled span/file criteria regress.
records.mechanism: When the first corrected terminal submission still fails the existing exhaustive schema or provenance validator, return the complete diagnostic once more and allow one final correction. Keep read-only evidence recovery available for provenance repair, count every failed and corrective model token, permit no repository effects, and stop after the second rejection.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; useful reasoning-state continuity after actual recycling, with the fixed acceptance target and cumulative model input plus output tokens.
records.statement: A second schema-complete terminal correction, inside the unchanged 96K cumulative model-token cap and common to both arms, will recover GLM-5.3-flash final-selection validity without erasing failed attempts or the observed state quality signal.

records.claim: Round 21 accounted all 56 cells. The only cell to use two terminal corrections still ended invalid because GLM repeatedly returned schema-valid terminal JSON as content instead of the declared tool. Separately, H25 missed span, file and validity gates while state used fewer model tokens.
limitations: Native evidence selection does not establish repair correctness, semantic retention, transfer or clearance.
One credential bridge timeout censored a state branch before provider dispatch.
One protocol-invalid response was semantically valid but natively scored zero under the frozen rule.
observed_markers: 1 terminal protocol invalid after two corrections
